'''Dark Lord666 Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Dark Lord666]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-21765">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21765 Maelstrom the Merchant Deck], DeckTech (Emperor "Dark Lord666" Palpatine, 26 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21765/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21765/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015151055/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21765/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dark Lord666]]
* '''Published:''' 26 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Maelstrom the Merchant Deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 LU Lord666 LS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck cycles through your entire reserve deck in two turns allowing you to set up massive battles, drains and regeneration before the opponent can react.
